fact: The High Commission for Digitalisation presented an SDK for secure biometric documents (passport, national ID card, driving licence) to the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Startups and Micro-enterprises, as components for digital solutions that require identity verification.

The Sports Ministry says holders of the national digital identity issued by the HCN can now access its WADHIFATI platform without creating an account, the user being identified through the unified digital identity.

Algeria officially launched electronic signatures and certification on 16 January at a ceremony attended by the Minister of Post and Telecommunications, with ARPCE designated the national electronic certification authority, according to the ministry statement reported by We Are Tech.

About a month before the launch, the National People's Assembly and the Governmental Electronic Certification Authority (AGCE) signed a framework agreement to integrate electronic certification and signature services.
Algeria's Ministry of Interior presentation says a digital identity was launched at large scale in 2025 and integrated into the national digital services portal.

Bank of Algeria governor Lebbou announced a binding KYC instruction for all banks, to identify and verify clients' identity, due in the days after the article; the article does not name the national ID.

Bank of Algeria Instruction 04-2026 of 30 April 2026, in force from signature, requires banks, financial institutions and Algerie Poste financial services to verify customer identity before and during a relationship; the national ID is not named.

Echorouk reports CNEP-Banque, Housing Bank for Trade and Finance and Banque Nationale d'Algerie are verifying customers' identity and updating files, which can require a valid identity card; it does not say checks are made against the national ID register.

The Ministry of the Interior says the CNIBE biometric ID card carries an electronic authentication certificate and a PKI platform, and that generalised use of the card to authenticate users on the secure-document and civil-status issuance platforms was launched.
TSA reports that the newly launched public procurement portal offers electronic signature of documents under law 26-02 of 17 February 2026 on trust services.

iAfrica reports that the Dzair Digital Services portal, which has a digital identity system built in with the Ministry of the Interior, ran citizen pilots in March and April 2026 and was cleared for imminent launch at the government meeting of 25 May 2026.

Horizons reports the official launch on 16 February 2025 of electronic certification and signature services for businesses by the AECE, with three certificate types (ThequaSign, Thequa ID, Thequa entreprise), a certification authority operational since 2021 and the first token handed over.

Interior ministry director general Redouane Mahfoudi announced that digital identity, based on the biometric electronic ID card and accessed by citizens securely from their mobile phone, would start to be handed to citizens before the end of 2024.
